ingredients.name: very hot water, or as directed on the package

steps.instruction: Soak 2 cups of cracked wheat in 2 cups of very hot water for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Soak 2 cups of cracked wheat in 2 cups of very hot water, until the water is absorbed. This takes about 30 minutes.

steps.instruction: Drain any extra water and squeeze the wheat dry.
Combine the wheat, 1 chopped cucumber and 2 small chopped tomatoes in a bowl.
Add 1 bunch of sliced green onions and 1/2 cup of chopped mint.
Add 2 cups of chopped parsley and 1 clove of minced garlic.
Mix 1/2 cup of lemon juice and 3/4 cup of olive oil in a small bowl.
Add 1 tablespoon of pepper and 2 teaspoons of salt.
Stir the dressing into the salad mix.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
